_comment: Roles this instance owns: the people and agents that play a lane in its processes (processes/content/), each with the skills its lane's tasks need. Schema: cat-harness/schemas/role-graph.ts.
name: cqf-skills

roles.title: Knowledge engineer
roles.description: Turns clinical intent (a guideline, a DAK decision table, a logic requirement) into CQL libraries, PlanDefinitions and the FHIR resources that carry them.
roles.persona: A clinician-informaticist or an agent with the guideline open beside the editor; works in VS Code with the CQL extension, needs each answer cited to a spec version, and tests on synthetic patients only.

roles.title: Measure developer
roles.description: Writes a quality measure: its CQL, the Measure resource, test cases with expected populations, and the evaluation that checks them.
roles.persona: Works to a programme's deadline and style guide, moves test cases between VS Code and MADiE, and has to explain every population count that differs from the expected one.

roles.title: IG author
roles.description: Keeps the FSH, the IG configuration and the build of a content IG, and packages its artifacts.
roles.persona: Lives in sushi-config.yaml, ig.ini and qa.html; wants pinned versions and a clean build, not background on FHIR.

roles.title: Skill maintainer
roles.description: Keeps this fork's skills, their evals and the knowledge-graph view, syncs from cqframework and offers skills of general use back.
roles.persona: The fork's owner or an agent acting for them: adds a skill only with evals, marks it draft until checked by running, and never merges into cqframework.

roles.title: cqframework maintainer
roles.description: A maintainer of cqframework/cqf-skills who reviews a skill this fork offers upstream.
roles.persona: Outside this repository: holds the upstream review bar (claims cited to code or spec, checked by running, evals that beat the baseline).
